detail.body:
## Motivation

GLM-5.3-Flash KDA prefill launches separate kernels for Q/K normalization, gate activation and chunk-local scan, the intra-chunk solve, W/U/Kg materialization, recurrence, and output.

AITER's merged [ROCm/aiter#5866](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5866) provides `aiter.ops.triton.attention.chunk_kda`, which fuses the prepare work and uses a recurrent walk kernel for state and output. Merged [ROCm/aiter#6672](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6672) adds the BF16 state-cache load/store required by GLM-5.3 while retaining FP32 recurrence.

## Modifications

- Add `aiter` as a KDA prefill backend selected by `--linear-attn-prefill-backend aiter`.
- Default KDA prefill to AITER on gfx950 when the BF16-capable operator is installed. `--linear-attn-prefill-backend triton` remains the explicit opt-out.
- Route measured BF16 `K=V=128`, BT=64 prefill over a contiguous range: 64-16,384 total tokens, 1-8 sequences, and 8 or 16 local heads.
- Keep Triton for unsupported hardware, dtypes, dimensions, layouts, safe-gate contracts, speculative extend, unsupported tracking layouts, and shapes outside the measured range.
- Preserve `extra_buffer` prefix-cache tracking on the dominant single-sequence path by splitting at the tracked chunk boundary, retaining FP32 recurrence and snapshot state, then committing the final state once. Measured tracked dispatch starts at 8,192 tokens for TP4 and 14,336 for TP8; smaller or multi-sequence tracked batches stay on Triton.
- Forward caller-provided chunk indices and offsets; construct them only when absent.
- Resolve the optional AITER operator once at module load.
- Add gfx950 coverage for TP4/TP8 geometry, ragged boundaries, a production 16,384-token single-sequence case, invalid state indices, deterministic execution, CUDA-graph replay, metadata forwarding, FP32-state/tracking fallbacks, and non-gfx950 rejection.
- Register the kernel suite only on the MI35X runner.

This PR is blocked by [#47139](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47139), which updates the gfx942/gfx950 AITER pin to include ROCm/aiter#6672.

## Accuracy Tests

Focused validation on the submitted source passed **33 tests and 24 subtests** on MI355X. Coverage includes TP4/TP8 head geometry, ragged boundaries, production 16,384-token single-sequence parity with FP32 and BF16 state, tracked output/snapshot/final-state parity, padded `-1` state indices, untouched state slots, finite output, determinism, CUDA-graph replay, metadata forwarding, explicit fallbacks, source-less AITER capability detection, and backend policy.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Environment:

- Hardware: AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`)
- Docker image: `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261019`
- Model: `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`
- Submitted source SHA: `c95e2e60c1`
- AITER: `cf84c52f54` (merged ROCm/aiter#5866 plus ROCm/aiter#6672)

### Fused KDA prefill latency

Complete KDA prefill call from raw Q/K/V/gate/beta through final output and in-place BF16 state update. A 90-cell MI355X sweep covers 8/16 local heads, 1/2/3/4/8 sequences, and 64/128/256/512/1,024/2,048/4,096/8,192/16,384 total tokens. Every measured cell beat Triton.

| TP | Local heads | Sequences | Total tokens | Triton (µs) | AITER fused prefill (µs) | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 16 | 1 | 64 | 69.39 | 24.50 | **-64.70%** |
| 4 | 16 | 8 | 64 | 37.99 | 26.22 | **-30.98%** |
| 8 | 8 | 1 | 64 | 68.88 | 23.66 | **-65.65%** |
| 8 | 8 | 8 | 64 | 34.70 | 23.74 | **-31.58%** |

Tracked single-sequence prefill was measured separately because it runs two AITER segments to materialize the exact radix-cache snapshot:

| TP | Local heads | Total tokens | Triton (µs) | AITER tracked (µs) | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 16 | 8,192 | 1,234.87 | 984.21 | **-20.30%** |
| 4 | 16 | 16,383 | 1,678.46 | 837.65 | **-50.09%** |
| 8 | 8 | 14,336 | 1,118.83 | 673.03 | **-39.85%** |
| 8 | 8 | 16,383 | 1,228.14 | 700.29 | **-42.98%** |

### Agentic benchmark (InferenceX, aiperf)

GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4, TP4 on m12-17 GPUs 4-7. Both arms use source `c95e2e60c1`, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261019`, InferenceX `bee3405caf`, benchmark driver `861f305aa2`, and AITER `27b274d332` plus the three runtime files from ROCm/aiter#6672; only `--linear-attn-prefill-backend` differs.

| Concurrency | P90 Interactivity Triton (tok/s/user) | AITER | Delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 275.3 | 267.5 | -2.83% |
| 4 | 220.8 | 220.3 | -0.23% |

| Concurrency | Throughput/GPU Triton (tok/s) | AITER | Delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 6,065 | 6,018 | -0.77% |
| 4 | 8,735 | 8,810 | +0.86% |

Both arms completed without a scheduler crash or OOM; profiled-request error rate was 0.3%. The latest power-of-two dispatch counters were 2,890/8,192 AITER calls at concurrency 1 and 4,828/16,384 at concurrency 4; aligned 16K chunks use AITER while short tracked tails retain Triton.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). The backend flag and dependency requirements are documented in code and this PR.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed) guidance.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Scoped syntax, isort, Ruff, Ruff format, codespell, registered-test validation, and `git diff --check` pass.

+import inspect
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.fla.index import (
+    prepare_chunk_indices,
+    prepare_chunk_offsets,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels.kda_triton import TritonKDAKernel
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels.kernel_backend import (
+    LinearAttnKernelBase,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+
+_CHUNK_SIZE = 64
+_MIN_TOKENS = 64
+_MAX_TOKENS = 16384
+_MAX_SEQUENCES = 8
+_TRACKED_MIN_TOKENS = {16: 8192, 8: 14336}
+
+
+def _load_chunk_kda():
+    if not is_gfx95_supported():
+        return None, False
+    try:
+        from aiter.ops.triton.attention import chunk_kda as module
+    except (ImportError, ModuleNotFoundError):
+        return None, False
+    # ROCm/aiter#5866 provides chunk_kda, but only ROCm/aiter#6672 lets
+    # gfx950 load/store the BF16 state cache used by GLM-5.3.
+    try:
+        supports_bf16_state = "torch.bfloat16" in inspect.getsource(
+            module.chunk_kda_walk
+        )
+    except (OSError, TypeError):
+        supports_bf16_state = False
+    return module.chunk_kda, supports_bf16_state
+
+
+_AITER_CHUNK_KDA, _AITER_SUPPORTS_BF16_STATE = _load_chunk_kda()
+
+
+def aiter_kda_prefill_available() -> bool:
+    return _AITER_CHUNK_KDA is not None and _AITER_SUPPORTS_BF16_STATE
+
+
+class AiterKDAPrefillKernel(LinearAttnKernelBase):
+    """gfx950 AITER chunk-KDA prefill with a Triton fallback."""
+
+    supports_track_state_snapshot: bool = True
+    supports_safe_gate: bool = True
+
+    def __init__(self, triton_fallback: Optional[TritonKDAKernel] = None):
+        if not is_gfx95_supported():
+            raise ValueError("AITER KDA prefill requires gfx950")
+        if _AITER_CHUNK_KDA is None:
+            raise ValueError("AITER KDA prefill requires merged ROCm/aiter#5866")
+        if not _AITER_SUPPORTS_BF16_STATE:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AITER KDA prefill with GLM-5.3 BF16 state requires merged "
+                "ROCm/aiter#6672"
+            )
+        self._triton = triton_fallback or TritonKDAKernel()
+        self._dispatches = 0
+        self._aiter_dispatches = 0
+        self._logged_rejections = set()
+
+    def decode(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        raise NotImplementedError("AiterKDAPrefillKernel is prefill-only")
+
+    def target_verify(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        raise NotImplementedError("AiterKDAPrefillKernel is prefill-only")
+
+    def _fallback(
+        self,
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        g,
+        beta,
+        *,
+        ssm_states,
+        cache_indices,
+        query_start_loc,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        self._record_dispatch(False)
+        return self._triton.extend(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            g,
+            beta,
+            ssm_states=ssm_states,
+            cache_indices=cache_indices,
+            query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+
+    def _record_dispatch(self, use_aiter: bool) -> None:
+        self._dispatches += 1
+        self._aiter_dispatches += int(use_aiter)
+        if self._dispatches & (self._dispatches - 1) == 0:
+            from sglang.srt.utils.common import rank0_log
+
+            rank0_log(
+                "AITER KDA prefill dispatch: "
+                f"hits={self._aiter_dispatches}/{self._dispatches}"
+            )
+
+    def _log_rejection(
+        self,
+        *,
+        q,
+        ssm_states,
+        num_sequences,
+        beta_is_raw,
+        lower_bound,
+        return_intermediate_states,
+        track_state,
+        track_chunk_idx,
+        track_chunk_idx_cpu,
+        is_spec_decode,
+    ) -> None:
+        signature = (
+            q.shape[1],
+            q.shape[-2],
+            num_sequences,
+            str(q.dtype),
+            str(ssm_states.dtype),
+            beta_is_raw,
+            lower_bound,
+            return_intermediate_states,
+            track_state is not None,
+            track_chunk_idx is not None,
+            track_chunk_idx_cpu is not None,
+            bool(is_spec_decode),
+        )
+        if signature in self._logged_rejections or len(self._logged_rejections) >= 8:
+            return
+        self._logged_rejections.add(signature)
+        from sglang.srt.utils.common import rank0_log
+
+        rank0_log(f"AITER KDA prefill fallback contract: {signature}")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _single_sequence_metadata(
+        length: int, source: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        num_chunks = (length + _CHUNK_SIZE - 1) // _CHUNK_SIZE
+        query_start_loc = source.new_tensor([0, length])
+        chunk_indices = torch.stack(
+            (
+                torch.zeros(num_chunks, device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype),
+                torch.arange(num_chunks, device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype),
+            ),
+            dim=1,
+        )
+        chunk_offsets = source.new_tensor([0, num_chunks])
+        return query_start_loc, chunk_indices, chunk_offsets
+
+    def _run_aiter(
+        self,
+        *,
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        g,
+        beta,
+        A_log,
+        dt_bias,
+        lower_bound,
+        query_start_loc,
+        chunk_indices,
+        chunk_offsets,
+        initial_state=None,
+        output_final_state=False,
+        state_cache=None,
+        cache_indices=None,
+    ):
+        return _AITER_CHUNK_KDA(
+            q=q,
+            k=k,
+            v=v,
+            g=g,
+            beta=beta,
+            A_log=A_log,
+            dt_bias=dt_bias,
+            lower_bound=lower_bound,
+            cu_seqlens=query_start_loc,
+            chunk_indices=chunk_indices,
+            chunk_offsets=chunk_offsets,
+            scale=k.shape[-1] ** -0.5,
+            out=v,
+            initial_state=initial_state,
+            output_final_state=output_final_state,
+            state_cache=state_cache,
+            state_indices=cache_indices,
+            has_initial_state=(
+                cache_indices >= 0 if cache_indices is not None else None
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def _extend_single_tracked(
+        self,
+        *,
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        g,
+        beta,
+        A_log,
+        dt_bias,
+        lower_bound,
+        ssm_states,
+        cache_indices,
+        track_state,
+        track_chunk_idx_cpu,
+    ):
+        track_chunk = track_chunk_idx_cpu[0]
+        split = track_chunk * _CHUNK_SIZE
+        total = q.shape[1]
+        if track_chunk < 0 or split >= total:
+            return None
+
+        safe_index = cache_indices.clamp_min(0).long()
+        valid = cache_indices >= 0
+        initial_state = ssm_states.index_select(0, safe_index).float()
+        initial_state = torch.where(
+            valid.view(-1, 1, 1, 1), initial_state, torch.zeros_like(initial_state)
+        )
+        output = v
+        state = initial_state
+
+        if split:
+            qsl, chunk_indices, chunk_offsets = self._single_sequence_metadata(
+                split, cache_indices
+            )
+            _, state = self._run_aiter(
+                q=q[:, :split],
+                k=k[:, :split],
+                v=output[:, :split],
+                g=g[:, :split],
+                beta=beta[:, :split],
+                A_log=A_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                lower_bound=lower_bound,
+                query_start_loc=qsl,
+                chunk_indices=chunk_indices,
+                chunk_offsets=chunk_offsets,
+                initial_state=state,
+                output_final_state=True,
+            )
+
+        track_state.copy_(state)
+        suffix = total - split
+        if suffix:
+            qsl, chunk_indices, chunk_offsets = self._single_sequence_metadata(
+                suffix, cache_indices
+            )
+            _, state = self._run_aiter(
+                q=q[:, split:],
+                k=k[:, split:],
+                v=output[:, split:],
+                g=g[:, split:],
+                beta=beta[:, split:],
+                A_log=A_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                lower_bound=lower_bound,
+                query_start_loc=qsl,
+                chunk_indices=chunk_indices,
+                chunk_offsets=chunk_offsets,
+                initial_state=state,
+                output_final_state=True,
+            )
+
+        current = ssm_states.index_select(0, safe_index)
+        committed = torch.where(
+            valid.view(-1, 1, 1, 1), state.to(ssm_states.dtype), current
+        )
+        ssm_states.index_copy_(0, safe_index, committed)
+        return output
+
+    def extend(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        g: torch.Tensor,
+        beta: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        A_log: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        dt_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
+        beta_is_raw: bool = False,
+        return_intermediate_states: bool = False,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
+        num_tokens = q.shape[1]
+        num_sequences = query_start_loc.numel() - 1
+        track_state = kwargs.get("track_state")
+        track_chunk_idx = kwargs.get("track_chunk_idx")
+        track_chunk_idx_cpu = kwargs.pop("track_chunk_idx_cpu", None)
+        tracked = (
+            return_intermediate_states
+            or track_state is not None
+            or track_chunk_idx is not None
+        )
+        supported = (
+            not kwargs.get("is_spec_decode")
+            and beta_is_raw
+            and A_log is not None
+            and A_log.is_contiguous()
+            and dt_bias is not None
+            and dt_bias.is_contiguous()
+            and lower_bound is not None
+            and -5.5 <= lower_bound < 0
+            and _MIN_TOKENS <= num_tokens <= _MAX_TOKENS
+            and 1 <= num_sequences <= _MAX_SEQUENCES
+            and ssm_states.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)
+            and cache_indices.dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64)
+            and q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and k.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and v.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and g.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and q.ndim == 4
+            and q.shape[0] == 1
+            and q.shape[-2] in (8, 16)
+            and q.shape[-1] == 128
+            and k.shape == q.shape
+            and g.shape == q.shape
+            and v.shape == q.shape
+            and q.stride()[2:] == (128, 1)
+            and k.stride()[2:] == (128, 1)
+            and v.stride()[2:] == (128, 1)
+            and g.stride()[2:] == (128, 1)
+            and beta.shape == q.shape[:-1]
+            and beta.stride(-1) == 1
+            and A_log.numel() == q.shape[-2]
+            and dt_bias.numel() == q.shape[-2] * 128
+            and (
+                not tracked
+                or (
+                    return_intermediate_states
